newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr ends at 8-yr low on firm US dlr abroad.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr ends at 8-yr low on firm US dlr abroad.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed at an eight-year low against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday, reflecting the strength of the American currency overseas, dealers said.
The local dollar dipped as low as T$27.958 before recovering mildly to end at T$27.948 against Tuesday's T$27.934 close.
Wednesday's finish surpassed a previous eight-year low of T$27.939 set last Wednesday. The local unit has not closed lower since finishing at T$28.03 on January 7, 1989.
Turnover through dealers was heavy at US$319.5 million.
Dealers said the Taiwan dollar's downturn reflected mainly the U.S. currency's strength against the German mark.
They added that outflow of foreign equity funds triggered by recent profit-taking in Taiwan's stock market also exacerbated the Taiwan dollar's fall.
"U.S. dollar demand was pretty strong today amid foreign equity fund outflows and investors' reaction to the greenback's firm trend overseas," said one dealer.

The Taiwan Stock Exchange said foreign funds posted a net selling of T$7 billion on Tuesday and T$1.9 billion on Wednesday in the stock market, which fell 2.88 percent on Tuesday and another 1.77 percent on Wednesday to close at 9,381.06 points.
Dealers said they also saw some overseas speculation in the form of non-delivery forward trading.
"NDF speculation is quite natural when the U.S. dollar firms overseas," said another dealer.
Dealers said the central bank intervened in late trade to smooth the Taiwan dollar's depreciation, but the defence was relatively moderate.
"The central bank generally leaves the market alone if the demand for U.S. dollar is mostly non-speculative commercial demand and if the Taiwan dollar's fall is not too sharp," said the first dealer.

Central bank governor Sheu Yuan-dong last week gave his most explicit comment to date on the speculative pressures that have undermined several southeast Asian currencies in July -- saying Taiwan's dollar was not vulnerable.
A T$27.93-97 range was seen for Thursday.
